New England Private Wealth Advisors Holding in Apple (AAPL) Has Lifted by $374,335 as Stock Price Declined; Wintergreen Advisers Lowered Its Stake in British American Tobacco Plc (BTI) by $48.63 Million as Share Value Declined
April 26, 2018 - By Clifton Ray
David Winters decreased its stake in British American Tobacco Plc (BTI) by 74.79% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wintergreen Advisers Llc sold 736,847 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.55% with the market. The hedge fund run by David Winters held 248,333 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.64M, down from 985,180 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wintergreen Advisers Llc who had been investing in British American Tobacco Plc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $113.21 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.87% or $1 during the last trading session, reaching $54.6. About 2.12 million shares traded. British American Tobacco p.l.c. (NYSEMKT:BTI) has declined 15.61% since April 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.16% the S&P500.
New England Private Wealth Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. New England Private Wealth Advisors Llc bought 2,215 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 24,552 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.17 million, up from 22,337 at the end of the previous reported quarter. New England Private Wealth Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $838.06B market cap company. The stock increased 0.93% or $1.5164 during the last trading session, reaching $165.1664. About 9.22M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
